Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Navnish Negi, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Shushil Vashistha, learned S.C. for 
State/respondent nos.1 and 3.
3. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned counsel for Selecting 
Body/respondent no.2.
Impleadment Application (IA No.4 of 2026)
4. Today the matter is listed on impleadment application 
filed by the petitioner by which the petitioner wants to implead 
the last person selected for the post of Assistant Teacher, L.T. 
Grade (Special Education) in General Category.
5. There is no objection from the side of the respondent(s) if 
the impleadment application is allowed.
6. Accordingly impleadment application is allowed.
7. Let necessary impleadment be incorporated within a 
period of three days by supplying amended memo of parties.
8. If such amended memo of parties is filed by the counsel 
for the petitioner within three days, the Office is directed to 
issue notice to the newly impleaded respondent nos.5 and 6.
9. Steps to be taken within four days from today.
10. List this case on 30.10.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 18.08.2026
SK
